schedule.sizing: Largest common1-2-5 step no greater than shortest independently resolvable feature/4. calibration_arithmetic: A uses recorded affine coefficients/equations and original fit/check anchors; B uses recorded rational two-dimensional affine coefficients with used_for_transform versus independent ticks. Apply each pass coefficients to its original x/y; never refit or select an average. Preserve recorded source rounding. All original coefficients/anchors/check residuals are included here for audit.
time_origin_ambiguity: A theta10s residual -70/1457s (~-0.04804s, -3.5px) versus B +5/364s (~0.01374s). Tiny-hook/band choices are systematic timing ambiguity, not repeatability or a confidence interval.

mapping_caveats: Table3.3 PDF41 names p pitch/q roll; FigureC.1 PDF238 depicts p roll/q pitch. No automatic sensor accuracy or native axis assignment.
FigureC.1 control conventions (positive aileron positive roll; positive rudder negative yaw) are not native pilot-intent commands.
Predicted alpha/beta and fitted derivatives are not measured truth. No run IC borrowed from Flight4/PhaseII/other variants.
negative_result: Three of eight planned channels fail independent printed-anchor eligibility, and the other five contain substantial unpaired/occluded/gapped regions. No complete measured input/response pair is admitted for native replay or aircraft validation.
bounded_next_action: Retain these five research artifacts; seek a better legible primary original or published raw run data/errata identifying exact sensors, control signs, IC/configuration and calibration.
